CustomField.label: Group Level
CustomField.description: Groups the grid by this column when it opens: 1 for the outermost grouping, 2 and 3 for groupings inside it. Leave blank not to group by this column. Users can change the grouping from the column menu; the grid keeps each user's choice until they click Reset layout.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: To group the grid by this column when it opens, enter 1 for the outer grouping, or 2 or 3 for groupings inside it. Otherwise leave blank.
